adaptations: Compiled native subprocess extensions replace Hunk's TypeScript folder extensions while preserving one active file-view mode, synchronous key ownership, lifecycle ordering, and host-rendered rows.

Hunk's awaited React confirmation becomes a declarative native confirm callback. Reload cancellation submits false only after the replacement review is authoritative, so the resumed callback enters its mode against the new review and retains it.

Mode callback failures cross JSON-RPC as remote errors. Workdeck unwraps the terminal-safe remote detail before producing Hunk's attributed warning shape, while transport and protocol failures retain their host context.
